slide_message: Overall tracking quality is similar across methods because all consume the same YOLO detections; ID switches separate the trackers.

recommended_chart: Combo chart: bars for F1/MOTA, line for ID switches
slide_message: SORT slightly reduces ID switches compared with centroid at the default confidence threshold.
Raising confidence from 0.25 to 0.35 improves precision and ID stability but reduces recall.
Performance is strongest on straight-line motion and weaker on dark/occluded random motion.
ID switches quantify identity stability during crossings and occlusions.
